review_kind: AI-assisted repository review; human adjudication pending

findings.locator: The public record does not show an exercised authority
findings.issue: Historical Reform 0 rationale describes unobserved exercise; current contract requires affirmative absence for 0.
findings.disposition: Preserve historical result; require a new bounded assessment before current-contract reuse.

findings.issue: Synthetic distinction tests do not establish discrimination in source interpretation. The machine-readable H2 claim is narrower than a general validity reading of this row.
findings.disposition: Read H2 as executable fixture behavior; source interpretation remains untested under the current contract.

findings.issue: Seven compared items share one packet; all six substantive ratings use one category. They are not seven independent cases.
findings.disposition: Retain descriptive agreement only; report cases, raters, categories, and items separately.

findings.locator: Unmapped repository prose remains outside this audit
findings.issue: Passing mapped controls does not evaluate every repository statement or verify external source truth.
findings.disposition: Use a separate scope register for supplementary claims and retain manual source review.

findings.issue: The existing contribution is an implemented combination; novelty and comparative benefit remain unestablished.
findings.disposition: Add targeted comparison; retain provisional novelty until a documented wider search and review.

findings.locator: observed exercise affected the decision path
findings.issue: A substantive finding can arise through observed exercise or qualifying capability; these evidence routes support different descriptions.
findings.disposition: Preserve the contract; report which route supports every 2 in future studies and analyze routes separately.

findings.locator: Higher HIT findings predict lower harm or better repair
findings.issue: Practical authority can be exercised harmfully. Repair also overlaps the proposed outcome and can create circular prediction.
findings.disposition: Keep H5 untested. Any future study must separate predictor dimensions, observation windows, outcomes, and confounding.

findings.issue: The manuscript describes v0.6.5 while the software bibliography entry identifies v0.6.4.
findings.disposition: Preserve the historical entry; add a distinct v0.6.5 entry and use it for v0.6.5 descriptions.
